purpose: Secondary antecedent watershed and water-quality inputs for Jubilee research/backtesting. These sources are not direct local bottom-oxygen measurements and carry zero production forecast weight until validated against confirmed events and matched non-events.

source_families.name: EPA Water Quality Portal / ADEM Coastal Beach Monitoring
source_families.role: Historical/current runoff and microbiological-state proxy; never substitute for DO, salinity, stratification, or local bottom conditions.

source_families.name: Mobile Baykeeper historical SWIM reports

guardrails: Enterococcus is a runoff/fecal-indicator proxy, not a Jubilee mechanism measurement.
No bacteria result may be converted to dissolved oxygen, salinity, hypoxia, or stratification evidence.
Magnolia River/AWW physical measurements are regional proxies, not direct Eastern Shore bottom measurements.
Historical water-quality features receive zero production weight until they improve out-of-sample discrimination against matched non-event mornings.
Preserve raw values, units, timestamps, station IDs, provider, QC metadata, and source URLs before deriving features.
